module.name: speakcard
module.description: A language-learning sentence card: main sentence + smaller translation + optional reading note, each speakable with machine TTS via the app's window.mdpTts API — per line by language, or with a chosen engine and voice (Web Speech narrator, the TTS server's voice + prompt + its own options such as Chatterbox's language/accent, VOICEVOX style + pitch/intonation/volume, or a named voice preset), falling back when that engine cannot speak. Interactive: the speak buttons never advance the slide.
module.aiSpec:
Use for language-teaching slides (e.g. technical English): shows a MAIN sentence with a speak button, a smaller SUB line (the translation), and an optional READING NOTE (e.g. "100 °C = one hundred degrees Celsius"). Clicking a speak button reads that line aloud with the app's TTS (window.mdpTts): the narrator is picked automatically from the line's language, or named explicitly. While speaking, the words being read are highlighted in place (word-by-word for Web Speech; an approximate progressive fill for VOICEVOX). The speaker settings need an MDP build with window.mdpTts.speakerOptions; an older build reads each line by its language only.
Block module: 1–3 body sections split by `<!-- @ -->`: section 1 — the main sentence (Markdown; e.g. the English sentence) section 2 — the sub line / translation, rendered smaller (optional) section 3 — a reading note, rendered small in accent color, never spoken (optional) To flip the direction (Japanese main, English sub) just swap the texts AND set mainlang: ja-JP, sublang: en-US.
Parameters (each line — main… and sub… — has its own speaker): • mainlang (text, default en-US) — language of the main sentence (BCP-47; drives narrator pick). • mainengine (auto | webspeech | server | voicevox, default auto) — who reads the main line: auto = the app's narrator for that language (Web Speech for a language it cannot speak); webspeech = a browser/OS narrator; server = the TTS server set in the app (OpenAI-compatible: Irodori-TTS, OpenAI, Kokoro…); voicevox = the local VOICEVOX engine. • mainvoice (text, default '') — the voice for that engine: a Web Speech narrator name (substring ok, e.g. Zira; with auto it implies Web Speech), the TTS server's voice id, or a VOICEVOX style id (a number). Blank = that engine's default from the app's settings. `@name` = a voice preset saved in the app (engine + voice + prompt + options in one name, made with ⚙ → Save as preset); it overrides mainengine. A computer without that preset reads the line by its language. Use presets only when the author has them. • mainprompt (text, default '') — engine server only: how to speak (Irodori's voice description / OpenAI's instructions). Blank = the app's setting. • mainextra (text, default '') — engine server only: the TTS server's own options as name=value pairs, e.g. Chatterbox `mainextra: "cfg_weight=0.3, exaggeration=0.7"` (cfg_weight = how much of the reference voice's accent stays; 0 removes it). A value containing , or ; goes in single quotes. Only options that server takes are sent; its language option is filled from mainlang unless set here. Blank = the app's setting. • mainpitch / mainintonation / mainvolume (number, default blank) — engine voicevox only: pitchScale (-0.15–0.15), intonationScale (0–2), volumeScale (0–2). Blank = VOICEVOX's own. • sublang (text, default ja-JP), subengine, subvoice, subprompt, subextra, subpitch, subintonation, subvolume — the same for the sub line. • subspeak (boolean, default false) — also give the sub line a speak button (default: only the main sentence is speakable). • speaker (number, default -1) — older form: VOICEVOX style id for whichever line is Japanese while its engine is auto (-1 = not used). Prefer subengine: voicevox, subvoice: <id>. • rate (number, default 1) — speaking rate for both lines (0.5–2; slower for learners). • fallback (auto | webspeech | none, default auto) — when the chosen engine cannot speak (not running, not set up, an unknown voice): auto = the app's narrator if it is another engine that speaks the language, then Web Speech; webspeech = straight to Web Speech; none = stay silent. The ▶ button's tooltip then says what happened. • highlight (boolean, default true) — highlight the words as they are spoken. • size (select sm|md|lg, default md) — overall text scale. • color (color, default var(--accent-color)) — speak-button and reading-note color. A value with a comma or a double quote (a prompt) goes in double quotes, inner " escaped as \".
The card itself is UNDECORATED (no frame/background) — wrap it in @callout, @bubble, @infobox etc. when a framed look is wanted.
Cross-surface: clicking ▶ on ANY surface (presenter tool, remote) plays the audio on the OWNER surface (the slideshow / preview driving the display); button state and the read-along highlight stay in sync on every surface.
Script/bus control: give the card a stable address with `tag: ex1`, then a @script can play it and wait for the audio to finish before narrating on: `[[emit-wait: cmd:ex1 play main | 例文①]]` (use `play sub` for the sub line, `stop` to stop). In the presenter view the marker appears as a clickable chip.
Example: <!-- @speakcard mainlang: en-US, sublang: ja-JP, mainvoice: Zira, rate: 0.9 --> Water **boils** at 100 °C at atmospheric pressure. <!-- @ --> 水は大気圧下で 100 °C で沸騰する． <!-- @ --> 100 °C = *one hundred degrees Celsius* <!-- @end -->
Example — English by the TTS server, the translation by VOICEVOX: <!-- @speakcard mainengine: server, mainvoice: alloy, mainprompt: "Calm, clear lecturer voice", subspeak: true, subengine: voicevox, subvoice: 3, subintonation: 1.2 --> This paper proposes a new compression method. <!-- @ --> 本論文では新しい圧縮手法を提案する． <!-- @end -->
Example — a Chatterbox server with the speaker's own (Japanese-accented) voice, accent reduced: <!-- @speakcard mainengine: server, mainvoice: my-voice, mainextra: "cfg_weight=0.2" --> The results are summarized in Table 2. <!-- @ --> 結果を表 2 にまとめる． <!-- @end -->

param.name: mainlang
param.label: Main language
param.desc: BCP-47 language of the main sentence (picks the narrator), e.g. en-US, ja-JP.

param.name: mainengine
param.label: Main speaker: engine
param.options: auto:Auto (by language / the app's narrator),webspeech:Web Speech (browser),server:TTS server,voicevox:VOICEVOX
param.desc: Who reads the main line. Auto = the app's narrator for the language.

param.name: mainvoice
param.label: Main speaker: voice
param.desc: Web Speech narrator name, the TTS server's voice id, a VOICEVOX style id, or @name for a saved preset — pick from the list or type. Blank = the engine's default.

param.name: mainprompt
param.label: Main speaker: prompt
param.desc: How the TTS server should speak (Irodori: voice description; OpenAI-type servers: instructions). Blank = the app's setting.

param.name: mainextra
param.label: Main speaker: server options
param.desc: The TTS server's own options (e.g. Chatterbox's accent cfg_weight, exaggeration), written name=value, … — only those the server takes are sent. Blank = the app's setting.

param.name: mainpitch
param.label: Main speaker: pitch
param.desc: VOICEVOX pitchScale (-0.15 to 0.15). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: mainintonation
param.label: Main speaker: intonation
param.desc: VOICEVOX intonationScale (0 to 2). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: mainvolume
param.label: Main speaker: volume
param.desc: VOICEVOX volumeScale (0 to 2). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: sublang
param.label: Sub language
param.desc: BCP-47 language of the sub (translation) line.

param.name: subspeak
param.label: Sub speakable
param.desc: Also give the sub (translation) line a speak button.

param.name: subengine
param.label: Sub speaker: engine
param.options: auto:Auto (by language / the app's narrator),webspeech:Web Speech (browser),server:TTS server,voicevox:VOICEVOX
param.desc: Who reads the sub line. Auto = the app's narrator for the language.

param.name: subvoice
param.label: Sub speaker: voice
param.desc: Web Speech narrator name, the TTS server's voice id, a VOICEVOX style id, or @name for a saved preset. Blank = the engine's default.

param.name: subprompt
param.label: Sub speaker: prompt
param.desc: How the TTS server should speak. Blank = the app's setting.

param.name: subextra
param.label: Sub speaker: server options
param.desc: The TTS server's own options, written name=value, … — only those the server takes are sent. Blank = the app's setting.

param.name: subpitch
param.label: Sub speaker: pitch
param.desc: VOICEVOX pitchScale (-0.15 to 0.15). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: subintonation
param.label: Sub speaker: intonation
param.desc: VOICEVOX intonationScale (0 to 2). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: subvolume
param.label: Sub speaker: volume
param.desc: VOICEVOX volumeScale (0 to 2). Blank = VOICEVOX's own.

param.name: speaker
param.label: VOICEVOX speaker (older form)
param.desc: VOICEVOX style id for a Japanese line whose engine is Auto (-1 = not used). Prefer Sub speaker: engine = VOICEVOX.

param.name: rate
param.label: Rate
param.desc: Speaking rate for both lines (0.5-2).

param.name: fallback
param.label: If the engine cannot speak
param.options: auto:The app's narrator then Web Speech,webspeech:Web Speech,none:Stay silent
param.desc: Used when the chosen engine is not running, not set up, or lacks the voice. The ▶ tooltip says what happened.

param.name: highlight
param.label: Read-along highlight
param.desc: Highlight the words as they are spoken.

param.name: size
param.label: Size
param.desc: Overall text scale of the card.

param.name: color
param.label: Accent color
param.desc: Speak-button and reading-note color.
